subject: ela
intro: Analyze how complex ideas and events interact.

items.prompt:
One factor affecting another is an:
A) interaction
B) index
C) title

A chain of causes and effects is a:
A) sequence
B) rhyme
C) font

An idea can:
A) persuade people to act
B) do nothing
C) only be printed

Read.

Cheaper printing spread literacy, which created a public that demanded reform.

This BEST shows:
A) a chain in which each factor causes the next
B) unconnected events
C) that books write themselves
items.answer: A) a chain in which each factor causes the next

steps: Chain of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a chain in which each factor causes the next

items.prompt:
Read.

A thinker's economic idea persuaded reformers, whose policies reshaped trade.

The interaction runs:
A) idea -> reformers -> policies -> changed trade
B) trade changed on its own
C) nothing is connected
items.answer: A) idea -> reformers -> policies -> changed trade

steps: Chain of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) idea -> reformers -> policies -> changed trade

items.prompt:
Why trace how factors INTERACT over a text?
A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed
B) to count words
C) to ignore the topic
items.answer: A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed

steps: Chains of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed

items.prompt:
Read.

War drove rapid advances in medicine, which after the war saved millions of civilian lives, which in turn fueled rapid population growth.

The BEST description is:
A) a sequence in which each development sets up the next
B) unrelated facts
C) population growth caused the war
items.answer: A) a sequence in which each development sets up the next

solution.answer: A) a sequence in which each development sets up the next

items.prompt:
To analyze a COMPLEX set of ideas and events, a reader should:
A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text
B) read only the first line
C) ignore the connections
items.answer: A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text

steps: Follow the interactions. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text
